newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Incentive Q1 to rise to 921 mln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Incentive Q1 to rise to 921 mln skr.

text.p: Swedish investment company Incentive is expected to post a pre-tax profit of 921 million crowns in the first quarter of the year, a Reuter poll of seven analysts showed on Friday.
The figure includes a capital gain of 425 million crowns from sales of shares in Wabco and Electrolux.
In the first quarter of 1996 the company posted a profit in its own operations of 826 million crowns, including a one-off gain of 570 million crowns.
For full-year 1997 the company is expected to post a profit of 4.16 billion crowns including capital gains of 1.23 billion crowns.
